meta.description: Executable version of benchmarks/corrupted-prompt-benchmark.md. Each row: a conversation, the reference extraction (what a correct extractor emits, per extraction/fact-lifecycle-prompt.md), and the expected findings. Run with poc/poc_verify.py in --reference mode (no API key, tests validator+engine) or --live mode (Claude Haiku extracts, tests the whole idea end to end).
meta.scoring: CORE/NUM/M3 rows pass when every expected finding kind is detected. CONTROL rows pass when zero hard conflicts and zero violations are reported (soft tensions are advisory and never count as false alarms). GAP rows are declared out of scope and are not scored. must_present/must_absent check that retraction removed exactly the right facts.
